andy-coradeschi.text: Campaign says that when he joined the board the district had one water source under state-mandated rationing, and it has since added four sources with no rationing.

source.title: Andy Coradeschi for LVMWD Director (campaign site)

andy-coradeschi.text: (2022) Defended a rate increase: about half was "directly due to the increased price of the water" from the State Water Project, the rest held below inflation; said "the Pure Water project effectively gives us 20% more water."

source.title: The Acorn: Las Virgenes water rates trickle higher (2022-12-15)
